source_scope: Same 250 fixed KWDLC train documents and all 1000 previously exposed slots. Research evaluation only, no training, no redistribution. Original rights limitations remain.
selection: No replacement, new source acquisition, or candidate-dependent target selection. Retain all 1000 slots and the original v1 statuses.

token_classes.phonetic: Nonempty reading contains only U+3041..U+3096 or U+30FC. Preserve original reading and surface exactly.
token_classes.literal: Nonempty surface equals reading byte-for-byte and every character has Unicode general category P* or S*. Phonetic takes precedence (long-vowel marks stay phonetic).
token_classes.unresolved: Any alternative annotation, unsupported token, original parse/bounds failure, or reconstructed span mismatch. No normalization, reading repair, or semantic certification.

views.whole: One converter request for the original full reading, including literal characters. This is a research hypothesis about input extent, not an observed user boundary.
views.literal_split: Preserve each literal span exactly; convert maximal contiguous phonetic token runs independently. No cross-EOS or inferred morpheme split inside a run.
views.morpheme_diagnostic: Convert every original phonetic morpheme independently and preserve literal tokens. Diagnostic for composition vs component support only; not a proposed user input policy.

reuse: Authenticate and reuse the 722 pure-reading converter snapshots from the immutable #39 run. Convert only new unique readings, using the identical frozen converter and dictionary. No user dictionary or context input.
metrics: Terminal statuses by original input-unit policy; measured and unmeasured retain separate denominators
Whole-reading source-exact Top1/5/6/10/32 counts; explicitly compare the same 747 original measured slots
Split/composed Top1 and all-components-present-at-k oracle for k=1/5/6/10/32; never call the Cartesian oracle whole-reading Top-k
Within the same slots, original whole-reading misses vs component-support failures and composed-support availability; no automatic reading-error, dictionary-error or pruning attribution
Literal-token counts, split-run bounds, new/reused request counts, converter search terminal statuses, failures and not-attempted outcomes
failure_policy: Any invalid snapshot, hash/identity mismatch, timeout or nonzero converter exit stops new execution. Preserve failed batch receipt and count remaining requests as not_attempted. No automatic retry or target replacement.
behavior_source: Historical reference exporter source 5eefa2ffe15297e563da281432cece56049a1b09 only; production checkout is not used.
